mood: The Road Remembered: a warm medley walking back down the whole journey in memory, every road leading home to the hometown theme in daylight.
core_styles: G major moving to C major
plucked harp arpeggios as the thread through every section
grateful, nostalgic, warm and a little teary

sections.name: Intro
sections.text: {a warm music-box statement of the first notes of the hometown theme over a soft string chord, then a drum pickup steps out onto the road}

sections.name: The First Road
sections.text: {a springy walking melody in G major, bright and adventurous, the first road out of town remembered}

sections.name: The Glowing Wood
sections.text: {a dreamy wondering melody in G Lydian with a raised fourth, glistening harp and bells, lighter drums, the glowing forest remembered}

sections.name: The Cold Miles
sections.text: {contrast: drums fall silent, a slow suspended melody in F minor on strings and soft lead, the long cold miles remembered, bittersweet}

sections.name: The Turn
sections.text: {the harmony rises out of the minor through a G dominant, the harp climbing, drums returning, the dawn answering}

sections.name: Home in Daylight
sections.text: {the hometown lullaby theme reprised whole in radiant C major, full warm band, bells crowning; the last bar settles on a half cadence that leads straight back into the walking theme}
styles: seamless loop back to the start of the walking theme
